metadata.title: AI Startup Manus Explores Hong Kong IPO After Unwinding Meta Deal - WSJ

content.text:
Artificial intelligence startup Manus is raising money after it severed ties with Meta Platforms META -1.43%decrease; down pointing triangle and is exploring future fundraising options including a public share listing, according to people familiar with the matter.
The company is in talks with prospective investors including investment firms IDG Capital and Boyu Capital to raise some $500 million in a funding round that would value it at around $4 billion, the people said.
